title: Balanced brackets
prompt:
Write balanced_brackets(text) that returns True if every (, [ and { in the text is closed by the right kind in the right order, ignoring all other characters; otherwise False.
Examples: '([]{})' -> True, '(]' -> False, '(()' -> False.
hints: Think of nesting boxes: the last box you opened must be the first one you close.
A list used as a stack (append to add, pop to remove the last) remembers the open brackets in order. What do you do with a closing bracket?

Plan: for each character: opening bracket -> push; closing bracket -> the stack must not be empty and its top must be the matching opener, else return False; ignore other characters. At the end the stack must be empty.

edge_hints.empty: No brackets at all is balanced (True).
edge_hints.basic: Check both kinds of failure: a closer with nothing open, and openers left over at the end.
